rows.grounds: ritual rice offering to be prepared
sacred formula to be recited; kept as ritual term
bringing down or invoking the mantra prior to recitation
intelligent ritual agent performing the actions

items.question: What ritual actions must the wise practitioner perform with the prepared oblation and mantra?
premises: The prepared offering is to be cooked as an oblation.
The mantra must be invoked before recitation.
The wise practitioner must recite the mantra again.
items.inference: The wise practitioner should cook the oblation and, having invoked the mantra again, recite it.
items.plain_english: The wise practitioner should cook the oblation, and having invoked the mantra again, should recite it.
